entities.summary: Veli Brijun is an island in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. It is located off the west coast of Istria in northern Adriatic and is the largest island in the Brijuni Islands archipelago. Like most of the archipelago, Veli Brijun is part of the Brijuni National Park, established in 1983.
